articles.title: Indore: Constable Dies After Snake Bite While Trying to Catch Snake
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Indore – In a tragic incident, Constable Santosh Choudhary, posted in the 1st Battalion of SAF at Sadar Bazar, lost his life after being bitten by a snake on Saturday night. Around 10 pm, Santosh was called to rescue a snake hiding in a window.

body.html:
Indore – In a tragic incident, Constable Santosh Choudhary, posted in the 1st Battalion of SAF at Sadar Bazar, lost his life after being bitten by a snake on Saturday night.

Around 10 pm, Santosh was called to rescue a snake hiding in a window. Known for his experience in catching snakes, he attempted to handle it but was bitten on his right hand. Despite being rushed to hospital and given anti-venom, the venom spread quickly and he could not be saved.

Santosh, who had served the police force for 17 years, is survived by his wife and two children. His colleagues and seniors praised him as a brave and dedicated officer. The battalion commandant recommended that he be honoured as a martyr for his service.

A video of the incident, now viral on social media, shows the moment Santosh attempted the rescue before the snake struck. The incident highlights the risks faced by officers and the dangers of snake handling without full protective measures.

articles.title: California: Indian Techie Shot Dead by Police in Santa Clara
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Santa Clara, California – A 30-year-old Indian engineer, Mohammad Nizamuddin, was shot dead by police on September 3. According to officials, police opened fire after Nizamuddin allegedly attacked his roommate with a knife.

body.html:
Santa Clara, California – A 30-year-old Indian engineer, Mohammad Nizamuddin, was shot dead by police on September 3.

According to officials, police opened fire after Nizamuddin allegedly attacked his roommate with a knife. When police intervened, he reportedly attempted to charge at them, leading to the firing that claimed his life.

Nizamuddin, originally from Mahabubnagar district, Telangana, had been working in the U.S. as a technician. His father, Mohammad Hasnuuddin, has written to External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar, requesting assistance in bringing his son’s body back to India.

The case has sparked concern among the Indian community in California, with questions being raised over the circumstances of the police firing.

articles.title: Agra Shocker: School Teacher Pulls Gun on Girl After She Refuses His ₹5,000 Offer
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Agra: A disturbing incident unfolded outside a restaurant in the Sikandra police station area, where a young woman was harassed at gunpoint. According to reports, the accused, Shyamvir Singh, a school teacher from Mathura, approached the girl in his car along with a companion.

body.html:
Agra: A disturbing incident unfolded outside a restaurant in the Sikandra police station area, where a young woman was harassed at gunpoint.

According to reports, the accused, Shyamvir Singh, a school teacher from Mathura, approached the girl in his car along with a companion. He offered her ₹5,000 to accompany him. When the woman refused, he pulled out a licensed pistol and threatened her.

The girl, however, showed courage, confronted him, and later filed a complaint. The video of the incident went viral on social media, prompting swift police action.

Within 24 hours, Sikandra police, along with surveillance and SOG teams, arrested the accused and seized both the car and the pistol used in the crime.

Police confirmed that the accused had also assaulted and threatened to kill the victim when she resisted. He is now in custody, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Maharajganj Murder Shock: Wife, Lover Arrested for Killing Husband and Dumping Body on Road
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Maharajganj (UP): Police have arrested Neha Rauniyar of Rajabari village and her lover Jitendra for the murder of Neha’s husband, Nageshwar Rauniyar. The duo strangled him to death and later dumped his body near Damki Gas Agency in Nichlaul.

body.html:
Maharajganj (UP): Police have arrested Neha Rauniyar of Rajabari village and her lover Jitendra for the murder of Neha’s husband, Nageshwar Rauniyar. The duo strangled him to death and later dumped his body near Damki Gas Agency in Nichlaul.

According to SP Somendra Meena, Nageshwar’s body was found on September 13 around 3 am. A case was registered on the complaint of his father, Keshav Raj, and both accused were later caught near the crime spot.

Police said Neha, who was in a year-long affair with Jitendra, conspired to eliminate her husband. She first served him alcohol, tied his hands and legs with a dupatta, and then, with Jitendra’s help, strangled him. The two carried the body on a bike and abandoned it on the roadside to pass it off as an accident.

Shockingly, Neha confessed that she had also given sleeping pills to her 5-year-old son, Advik, before committing the crime. The boy has now been handed over to his grandfather.

Villagers were left stunned when Neha admitted that it was Nageshwar himself who had introduced her to Jitendra, forcing her to continue the relationship, before their affair spiraled into a deadly conspiracy.

Both accused are now in jail, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Mandsaur Garba Practice Turns Shocking: Woman Kidnapped, 7 Arrested Including 2 Women
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mandsaur (MP): A dramatic kidnapping took place during Garba practice at Bhavsar Dharamshala in Khanpura late at night when four men and two women dragged away a woman into a car.

body.html:
Mandsaur (MP): A dramatic kidnapping took place during Garba practice at Bhavsar Dharamshala in Khanpura late at night when four men and two women dragged away a woman into a car.

Police said the victim, originally from Garoth, had left her alcoholic and abusive husband and was living in a live-in relationship with her boyfriend in Mandsaur after filing for divorce. Angered by this, her family members plotted the abduction.

When bystanders tried to stop the kidnappers, one of them brandished a pistol, creating panic. Acting swiftly, police set up a district-wide blockade. Within two hours, the Chandwasa outpost team intercepted the car and rescued the woman.

Superintendent of Police Vinod Kumar Meena confirmed the arrest of seven accused, including two women. They have been booked under kidnapping, the Arms Act, and other relevant sections.

Accused: Ramchandra, Manisha alias Bunty, Kamlesh alias Ghota, Fakira Chand, Shambhulal, Shyamabai, and Dinesh.

articles.title: SHOCKING: Aunt Marries Nephew at Police Station After Filing R@pe Case Against Him in UP
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Rampur, Uttar Pradesh: In a bizarre turn of events at Patwai police station in Rampur's Shahabad tehsil, a woman married her own nephew after initially accusing him of r@pe. The woman's husband, Noorpal, revealed that his wife had been having an affair with his nephew for three years.

body.html:
Rampur, Uttar Pradesh: In a bizarre turn of events at Patwai police station in Rampur's Shahabad tehsil, a woman married her own nephew after initially accusing him of r@pe.

The woman's husband, Noorpal, revealed that his wife had been having an affair with his nephew for three years. The nephew allegedly visited the woman when she was alone at home, even jumping over walls when Noorpal was away for work.

When confronted by her husband after villagers exposed the affair, the woman demanded he sever ties with her and let her stay with the nephew. She then filed a r@pe case against the nephew at Patwai police station, threatening him with imprisonment unless he married her.

At the police station, the woman put a garland around her nephew's neck and had him apply sindoor on her forehead, completing the marriage ceremony without divorcing her husband.

"I don't want to be dragged into this mess. I just want to live peacefully now," said Noorpal, who remained unaware of the three-year affair until neighbours informed him.

The incident has shocked the local community in Rampur district.

body.html:
A woman who was heard abusing an Army personnel in a viral audio clip has now apologised. She claimed she was frustrated due to personal issues and said, “I apologise for my mistake. My job is now at risk. I am like your younger sister.”

However, her explanation has drawn sharp criticism online, with many questioning whether frustration can justify insulting a soldier. Netizens accused her of playing the “victim card” by citing family problems.

Meanwhile, HDFC Bank issued a clarification that the woman is not their employee, countering false claims made on social media.
